prompts.prompt: Create one extremely polished educational 3D infographic for an elegant machine learning app named Pattern. Wide 3:1 composition, TRUE transparent alpha background, no rectangular plates, no floor, no backdrop, no checkerboard. Three evenly spaced free-standing scientific plots, each floating in negative space. Exact labels below in modern DM Sans type, muted cool blue-grey with contrast suitable on both pale blue-white and charcoal backgrounds: "Underfit", "Generalize", "Overfit". In each plot the EXACT SAME 14 small matte lavender spherical data points follow an arch (a broad inverted U) with subtle vertical scatter. Each plot has ONE satin ice-blue cylindrical curve, SAME blue in ALL THREE. First curve: straight gently rising line obviously misses arch. Second curve: smooth single arch follows broad trend without every point. Third curve: a continuous wildly zigzagging overflexible arch chases every noisy point. No orange, no gold, no green, no ivory, no opaque panels. No hollow circles. Minimal fine cool-blue axis strokes, no tick numbers. Restrained tactile frosted ceramic aesthetic, not glossy toy, beautiful soft ambient shadows intrinsic only to objects, precisely aligned baselines and labels. Clear, scientifically sensible, spacious compact height, sophisticated museum exhibit diagram. Palette blue #8CB3DE, lavender #B9A5DE, restrained graphite text #7484A2. No additional text. All content inside canvas with margin. Candidate A: tangible mathematical curves.

Create a sophisticated, extremely clean educational infographic as an isolated TRANSPARENT PNG, 3:1 wide format. Theme: generalization in machine learning. Three side-by-side floating sculptural plots with NO backing cards, NO background, NO floor, no orange whatsoever, no blue glow, no neon edges, no chrome. Materials: perfectly MATTE pale powder-blue silicone lines and matte muted lavender small data dots, soft diffuse illumination. All 3 plots have identical 12 dots arranged around the same broad smooth arch. All three fitted lines use IDENTICAL powder blue #97B7DC. Left has straight line missing the arch; middle single restrained smooth arch capturing the trend; right snake-like too-wiggly fit chasing individual points. Dots small, curves thin, minimal light bluish-grey axes, ample negative space. Clean rendered editorial diagram, museum-quality, elegant precise geometry, no chunky toy appearance. Below plots exact text "Underfit", "Generalize", "Overfit" in flat, crisp DM Sans medium, muted mid-lavender #968BB1, no text shadows or embossing. True alpha outside objects; never white or creamy rectangles. Aligned baselines, equal sizes. More beautiful and informative than a textbook. Every dot, line and glyph cleanly antialiased. Compact vertical layout. Candidate B.

Design a premium museum-grade 3D scientific illustration explaining underfitting, generalization and overfitting. Wide 3:1 landscape, true transparent alpha background. Three compact side by side isometric spatial sculptures, NO panels and NO ground plane. Each sculpture consists of an identical loose arch of little solid lavender beads suspended in space. A slim BLUE flexible spline attempts to fit the beads. The left spline is an overly rigid straight bar missing the arch. The middle spline is a relaxed smooth arch, passing amidst the same beads. The right spline is a dramatically over-bent wire chasing every bead with irregular tight waves. Use the exact same soft dusty blue color for all three splines, matte porcelain finish, no chrome, no saturated highlights, no glow. Lavender only for small beads. No orange, rings, gold or green. Soft real studio illumination with highly controlled surface realism. Silvery-blue tiny minimal axis ends are permissible, but no graph paper. At bottom neatly aligned flat DM Sans typography, medium-weight, muted cool grey-lavender #8b85a3, labels exactly: "Too rigid", "Learns the pattern", "Chases the noise". Slight isometric perspective makes this feel sculptural and elegant; rigorously maintain the same point layout in all three sculptures. Sophisticated scientific editorial art, clean alpha edges, no artifacts, understated tactile quality. All objects centered vertically with modest margins; compact height. Candidate C.
